avis.texte: This is literally a copy of The WISHFUL Yo Glow Honey Flower Enzyme Scrub that was limited edition by Huda Beauty except this product isnt so liquidy, its more of a cream like texture. I also find this product to be more gentle on my sensitive skin and didnt make it red or slightly itchy like the Huda one did. My skin felt baby smooth, soft and supple immediately after using this product. I can tell it exfoliated all the dead skin away. This product has the most lightest citrus/orange/tangerine smell to it, I barely noticed it even when I was using it around my nose, which the smell is from the fruit enzymes, not added fragrance. I will NOT be returning this☺️ the only thing I will say is I believe this should be more in the $15-20 price range even though you do get a decent amount of product.

avis.titre: Good gommage exfoliator, great scent, nice price.
avis.texte: This is a nice gommage exfoliating cleanser. Gommage means erase in French, and if you aren't familiar with this type of exfoliator, a pencil eraser is a good comparison. Basically, you massage this kind of product into your skin and it uses enzymes to slough off dead skin cells, which then mix with the product to form little white balls, much like a pencil eraser. It's a very satisfying experience! Saturday Skin's RubADub Refining Peel gel is a very gentle product. I like the light citrusy scent. It's easy to use, though it is thicker and has a LOT more ingredients than my favorite exfoliator, Cure Natural Aqua Gel. But it is also a lot less expensive than Cure Natural Aqua Gel, so it will continue to have a place in my exfoliating routine. A little goes a long way, so a tube should last for a long time. I will probably use this once a week. It is definitely a great product to include in any Girls' Night In or Spa Sunday afternoon! I hope my experience with this product might help YOU make a more informed purchase. Happy shopping!
This is my holy grail for exfoliating my face. It does such a great job and you can literally feel it working. Love love love this product.

avis.titre: Watch the dead skin ball up all over your face!
avis.texte: I've never used a skincare product like this before. Although I don't like synthetic perfumes in skincare products, the scent in this gel is subtle, clean and uplifting. It's also near the bottom of the ingredient list, which is often not the case in commercial skincare products. This product is a lightweight, whipped gelcream that you apply to your face after cleansing it's okay if you wake up with a makeup free face and want to use it alone. So here is how you use it while your skin is still damp, massage it in circular motions into your skin for about 30 seconds or longer. Avoid your eyes and lips and pay attention to your porey Tzone area! Instantly, pieces of dead skin residue begin to peel off, even though it doesn't feel like any serious exfoliation is going on. The gel is cool, comfortable, and gentle on your skin. It's a pleasant experience, one that produces real results! This is not a peeling face mask like I expected. Instead, it's a gel that easily peels off your dead skin to reveal a brighter complexion! It quickly cleaned and cleared up my pores, especially around my nose, and left my skin feeling soft and smooth. I honestly didn't expect much for the price point, but love this so much it'll be a gift for everyone I know! Works great, gentle to skin while smells good. My skin is smooth and shiny after 12 minutes of fingertip cleaning in the shower. The only thing is it works so well, make sure to use fingers and not washcloth initially because it may be too str
